Hawks Hero Agency.text: The agency of Hawks, the Number Three hero at the start of the year, based in Fukuoka. Hawks is the youngest hero ever to reach the top ten: a quick, easygoing man in his mid-twenties with large crimson wings whose feathers he can detach and steer one by one, fine enough to sense vibrations and strong enough to carry people. He is so fast that his own sidekicks often arrive only to file the paperwork. The agency is small and lean: a handful of sidekicks, a dispatch desk and a press office answering questions about cases he closed an hour ago. Fans love his relaxed manner and his line that he wants a world where heroes have free time. The visible contradiction: the hero who talks about slowing down is the fastest worker in the country.
